substeps.label: Day 1
substeps.caption: The lab as set up: two Shuttles with every tray loaded and powered, the floor machines, two MiR250 + UR10e units on charge. The clock starts on a Monday at 06:00.

substeps.label: 1/4  Hour by hour
substeps.caption: Hour by hour, the first day. A person comes in 08:00-16:00 to change the atomizer's crucible; the arms, the MiR250s and the Shuttles do the rest, and keep going with the lights off.

substeps.label: 2/4  Day by day
substeps.caption: Day by day. The atomizer runs only while someone is on site: one run a day while the lab is commissioned, then three a weekday. The rest runs round the clock and over the weekends.

substeps.label: 3/4  Week by week
substeps.caption: Week by week. An alloy is fully tested about half a day after it is atomized. One in ten is promoted to a full plate of E8 bars, which takes eight more atomizer runs.

substeps.label: 4/4  Month by month
substeps.caption: Month by month, to the end of the first year. The counters are a model built from each chapter's step times and the assumptions in notes/timelapse.md, not measurements.
